text:
It was a busy day of planning and organization! We started by confirming your schedule, noting the Standup at 9:30 AM and the Retro later this afternoon.

The bulk of our time today focused on detailing your upcoming Melbourne trip. First, I searched for flights from Canberra to Melbourne, finding that Qantas and Virgin offer several daily options starting around $120, though I reminded you to check the live pricing before booking. Since you were leaning toward a 6:10 PM flight on Friday and returning Monday morning, I saved those preferences into your trip note. We also looked at what early December weather is typically like in Melbourne, keeping in mind that it can be changeable.

To help with the logistics, we created a packing list for three nights, covering everything from rain jackets to one smart outfit for dinner. You also asked me to search for good vegetarian restaurants in Fitzroy, and I found options like Smith & Daughters and Vegie Bar. Finally, I added both the suggested dinner spot and a placeholder for an afternoon gallery visit to your itinerary.

It looks like the biggest theme today was coordinating all the details for Melbourne! We also set that reminder for Friday morning so you don't forget to book those flights. When we wrapped up, you shared that what you are most looking forward to is the trip itself—getting out of town for a few days. I hope you get some time to stretch your shoulders tonight after all that planning!
